_meta.name: Resident population age 65 and older
_meta.source: computed from U.S. Census Bureau Population Estimates Program age-group counts (65 and older divided by total)
_meta.note: Computed from all-sexes age-65-and-older counts divided by all-sexes total resident population. Vintage list: 2000–2010 intercensal estimates for 2000–2009; 2010–2020 intercensal estimates for 2010–2019; Vintage 2025 estimates for 2020–2025. Newer vintage wins at 2010 and 2020. The 1970–1999 extension is deferred: the historical Census workbooks cover resident population plus armed forces overseas, or single-year ages without a published median, so they are not joined.
_meta.annualRule: July 1 resident population estimate; one observation per calendar year.
_meta.breaks: Intercensal/vintage splice at 2010 and 2020; census-base revisions can change estimates. July annual estimates are not replaced by April census/base observations.
